items.title: GFM has three remaining autolink boundary gaps; all corpus differences are classified
items.expected: Match all 672 pinned examples with their upstream extension flags; measure production extensions and final sanitization separately.
items.disclosure: The raw parser matches **662/672** exact HTML examples with upstream extension flags; **10 deviations** remain: three autolink boundaries (internal excess parentheses, entity-like URL suffixes, and plus signs in email domains), five newline differences, and two task-list class differences. Production HTML matches **593/672**; the sanitized browser DOM matches **619/672**, including **32 intentional sanitization differences**. Every difference is classified in the checked-in audit. Table alignment, redundant nested bold markup, common `www.` links, and GFM tag filtering are fixed.
items.baselineDisclosure: The pinned GFM corpus matches **582 of 672 exact HTML examples (86.6%)**; **90 deviations** are documented. These include serialization differences in void tags, task-list classes, and highlighted code, as well as differences in reference resolution, tables, nested emphasis, raw HTML, escapes, and extended autolinks. The guide lists the affected specification sections and counts.

items.title: HTML is sanitized after parsing
items.expected: Verify each behavior against cmark-gfm 0.29.0.gfm.13 / markdown-it 15.0.3; separate deliberate policy from unsupported upstream capabilities.
items.disclosure: GFM raw-text tags (including script, style, title, and iframe) are escaped as readable text before browser parsing. All output is then sanitized. Active scripts, event handlers, forms, embedded documents, arbitrary styles, SVG foreign objects, and animation cannot survive as active elements, even where the original parser would preserve them. Static SVG and MathML use a restricted presentation allowlist.
items.baselineDisclosure: HTML is sanitized after parsing. Scripts, event handlers, forms, embedded documents, arbitrary styles, SVG foreign objects, and animation are removed, even where the original parser would preserve them. Static SVG and MathML use a restricted presentation allowlist.

items.title: ECB decimal rate environment supplied to CalcFile
items.expected: The adapter supplies the pinned engine with validated decimal-string ECB rates only when actual calculations need external data. Online, cached/offline, missing, malformed and cancelled requests have deliberate results; the 37-case corpus remains unchanged.
items.disclosure: The shared service reads the browser-accessible official ECB data API and builds a validated daily XML snapshot while preserving decimal rate text and the latest publication date. Discontinued older series are excluded. CalcFile now supplies validated decimal-string ECB rates with their publication date, fetching only when the engine reports missing external data. Supported EUR-base conversions work online or with a valid cache. Refresh failures disclose older cached rates; malformed or unavailable data keeps source-line diagnostics. Cancellation discards late responses without cache writes. The original 37 required upstream conformance cases still pass. Pair/currency and rate-snapshot boundaries remain under CF-05.
items.baselineDisclosure: All 37 required upstream conformance cases pass, including cases with supplied exchange rates. The **Sheets UI supplies no currency-rate environment** to CalcFile, so cross-currency conversion reports missing external data.

items.title: Equation selection and bounded connected-constraint checks
items.expected: Verify each behavior against public Calca reference; licensed-app verification still needed; separate deliberate policy from unsupported upstream capabilities.
items.disclosure: Legacy and Structured blocks prioritize explicit assignments and the latest usable equation, possibly skipping unsupported or underdetermined relations. Scoped definitions checks all connected real scalar relations against candidate roots and reports conflicts; it is not a general simultaneous-system solver. Derived answers are not stored as assignments. Expressions depending on multiple or no roots report diagnostics; query the unknown directly. Identities report infinitely many solutions. Complete native-app equation selection and conflict behavior still needs verification.
items.baselineDisclosure: Explicit assignments take priority. Queries look backward for the most recent usable equation and may skip unsupported or underdetermined relations. This is not a simultaneous-equation consistency checker. Derived answers are not stored as assignments. An expression depending on multiple or no roots reports a diagnostic rather than choosing a root; query the unknown directly instead. Identities report infinitely many solutions rather than selecting an answer.

items.title: Definition semantics and native-app verification
items.expected: Verify each behavior against public Calca reference; licensed-app verification still needed; separate deliberate policy from unsupported upstream capabilities.
items.disclosure: Legacy and Structured blocks allow reassignment, share one document context, and use assignment-time values for resolved numeric definitions. Scoped definitions (calca-scopes-v1) retains the first visible definition, treats repeated definitions as constraints, resolves deferred dependencies and function free variables at query time, and scopes definitions/relations to headings and descendants. Child definitions cannot shadow inherited names. The public heading example is covered; child redefinition, deferred binding, conflict presentation, and Setext rules are explicit Sheets policies pending licensed-app comparison. State resets on every render.
items.baselineDisclosure: Numeric definitions use assignment-time values; unresolved definitions use current values when queried. Reassignment is allowed, headings do not create scopes, and state resets on every render. These behaviors differ from Calca.

items.title: Results use floating-point arithmetic with up to 12 significant displayed digits
items.expected: Verify each behavior against public Calca reference; licensed-app verification still needed; separate deliberate policy from unsupported upstream capabilities.
items.disclosure: Results use floating-point arithmetic with up to 12 significant displayed digits. Scoped relation checks allow 64 machine epsilons of relative error; solved unknowns use arithmetic magnitude, including terms lost to cancellation, without an absolute floor. These checks are numerical, not exact proofs. Expressions allow 4,000 characters and 1,000 syntax nodes. Legacy and Structured blocks allow 256 equations; Scoped definitions allows 256 definitions/relations together, with dependency/relation-expansion depth 32 and bounded query work. This numerical policy is not verified native Calca equivalence.
items.baselineDisclosure: Results use floating-point arithmetic with up to 12 significant displayed digits. Expressions are limited to **4,000 characters and 1,000 syntax nodes**, documents to **256 equations**, with additional bounds on definition expansion.

items.title: Calculation and literal Markdown block isolation
items.expected: The explicit Sheets structured-block profile isolates literal Markdown input, executes supported calculation blocks, and retains original source locations. Unprofiled documents keep legacy behavior.
items.disclosure: Structured blocks (calca-blocks-v1), also included in Scoped definitions (calca-scopes-v1), uses parsed Markdown boundaries: only calca-labelled fences, indented code, and standalone paragraph arrow expressions calculate. Literal language/unlabelled fences, TeX, Mermaid, inline code/math, headings, links, and HTML do not run as calculations. Legacy remains the default for unprofiled URLs and version-1 saved documents. This resolves Markdown block isolation in the explicit profile; it does not implement Calca’s complete input grammar.
items.baselineDisclosure: Every fenced or indented code block is calculation input, regardless of its language label. Literal code, math, or Mermaid fences can therefore produce calculation diagnostics. Arrow answers replace text in the preview; the editor source is retained. Built-in unit/constant names can conflict with unknown names.

items.title: Decimal resource bounds and remaining rounding options
items.expected: Support additional precision/rounding options only with pinned reference fixtures; keep explicit resource limits.
items.disclosure: Numeric literals are bounded at 256 digits, and arithmetic uses a 28-significant-digit context. Other advanced options, including automatic rounding-account postings, remain unsupported. These are separate from the resolved decimal/tolerance work.

items.title: Reserved names and remaining input grammar
items.expected: Audit remaining input grammar against Calca’s public reference and a licensed app; preserve deliberate expression guards.
items.disclosure: All Calca modes still evaluate one line at a time. Indentation-based multiline definitions, named arguments, multiple statements per line, and the original app’s broader prose/calculation inference remain unsupported. Built-in unit/constant names can conflict with unknown names; use distinct identifiers. Arrow answers replace preview text while the editor source remains intact. Forward calls to undeclared functions are unsupported. Unlisted built-in functions are rejected both as direct calls and as function values, so user-function arguments cannot bypass the allowlist. Scoped definitions rejects nested assignments in expressions and function bodies to preserve immutable bindings.
items.baselineDisclosure: Every fenced or indented code block is calculation input, regardless of its language label. Literal code, math, or Mermaid fences can therefore produce calculation diagnostics. Arrow answers replace text in the preview; the editor source is retained. Built-in unit/constant names can conflict with unknown names.

items.title: Heading-local immutable definitions in an explicit profile
items.expected: An explicit profile implements parent/child/sibling heading availability, preserves first definitions, resolves deferred numeric dependencies, and reports connected numeric conflicts; older profiles retain their results. Separate project policy from independently verified native behavior.
items.disclosure: Scoped definitions (calca-scopes-v1) adds immutable visible definitions, heading-local definitions/relations, deferred dependency ordering, cycle diagnostics, reverse linear/quadratic definitions, and connected real scalar constraint checks. The public-reference heading fixture is reproduced; broader native semantics remain under CALCA-04 audit. Legacy and Structured blocks retain their earlier semantics. Source links, version-2 saved documents, OAuth snapshots, exports and offline reloads preserve the selected mode; plain source files require reselecting it.
items.baselineDisclosure: Numeric definitions use assignment-time values; unresolved definitions use current values when queried. Reassignment is allowed, headings do not create scopes, and state resets on every render. These behaviors differ from Calca.

items.title: ECB base pairs, cache availability and changing external data
items.expected: Keep the pinned rate-table API and its supported currencies explicit; broader conversion behavior requires a separately verified adapter or newer reference target. Never invent missing rates or imply source links freeze external data.
items.disclosure: The pinned engine recognizes EUR, USD, GBP and JPY and converts only when one side is the rate table base. Sheets supplies the ECB EUR base, so direct non-EUR pairs and currencies such as CHF remain unsupported. Validated rates are cached for 24 hours; refresh failure may use an older snapshot with a notice and original date, and publications older than seven days are flagged. Offline conversion needs a previously cached snapshot plus installed app files; offline installation does not preload rates. Malformed feeds and corrupt/future cache entries are rejected. Requests have a twenty-second deadline. Optional storage may be unavailable or evicted. Source links, downloads and HashBin documents store source rather than rates; rendered HTML preserves the finished answers and date. The original daily XML download blocks cross-origin browser reads; the official ECB data API is used instead, with no document source in requests.
items.baselineDisclosure: The Sheets UI supplies no currency-rate environment to CalcFile, so cross-currency conversion reports missing external data.

items.title: Decimal-string ECB rates reach the rational parser
items.expected: Supply exact decimal strings to the pinned Hurmet rational parser; a real worker conversion with the shared ECB snapshot must produce the reference result.
items.disclosure: The Hurmet worker now supplies ECB decimal strings, including EUR = 1, instead of JavaScript numbers. This fixes the currency rational-parser runtime error. Validated shared rates use the 24-hour cache and a disclosed older fallback when refreshing fails. Missing rates retain diagnostics, and source links do not freeze rate snapshots. The shared service uses the CORS-readable official ECB data API rather than the blocked daily XML download.
items.baselineDisclosure: The worker supplied JavaScript numbers to Hurmet’s decimal-string rational parser, causing a runtime error for ECB currency calculations.
